prompt:
Generate a git commit message for a planning document.
Output in English only - all code, comments, commits, docs.
TYPE: feature
ID: CC-0089
TITLE: Add Prometheus metrics and ServiceMonitor sub-reconciler
SUMMARY: # GitHub Issue #122: Add Prometheus metrics and ServiceMonitor sub-reconciler

**Description**: Register custom Prometheus collectors in the Keystone operator: reconciliation duration histograms per s

CONTENT PREVIEW:
Feature: Add Prometheus metrics and ServiceMonitor sub-reconciler

# GitHub Issue #122: Add Prometheus metrics and ServiceMonitor sub-reconciler

**Description**: Register custom Prometheus collectors in the Keystone operator: reconciliation duration histograms per sub-reconciler, reconciliation error counters by condition type, fernet/credential key rotation age gauges (last rotation timestamp), and database sync job duration/failure counters. Add a ServiceMonitor CR emitted by a sub-reconciler or Helm template so Prometheus auto-discovers the operator metrics endpoint on port 8080.

**Motivation**: The operator has a metrics port (8080) configured in the Helm chart but emits no custom metrics. For production operational visibility, operators need to monitor reconciliation health, detect degraded conditions, and alert on key rotation failures. Without metrics, operators are flying blind.

**Affected Areas**:
- `operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller.go`
- `operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_deployment.go`
- `operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_secrets.go`
- `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/`

**Acceptance Criteria**:
- [ ] Reconciliation duration histogram registered per sub-reconciler
- [ ] Error counter by condition type incremented on failures
- [ ] Fernet/credential key age gauges expose last rotation timestamps
- [ ] ServiceMonitor template added to Helm chart (opt-in via values.yaml)
- [ ] Metrics endpo


<commit-best-practices>
<subject-line>
  <rule name="format">"plan(CC-0089): <short description>"</rule>
  <rule name="types">feat | fix | test | refactor | docs | style | chore</rule>
  <rule name="length">Max 50 chars recommended, 72 chars absolute maximum</rule>
  <rule name="style">Imperative mood ("add" not "added", "fix" not "fixed")</rule>
  <rule name="punctuation">No period at end, capitalize after colon</rule>
</subject-line>

<body optional="true">
  <rule>Blank line required between subject and body</rule>
  <rule>Wrap lines at 72 characters maximum</rule>
  <rule>Explain WHAT changed and WHY (not HOW)</rule>
</body>

<avoid>
  <rule>Include "WIP", "temp", "test", or placeholder text</rule>
  <rule>Commit unrelated changes in the same commit</rule>
  <rule>Use past tense ("added", "fixed", "changed")</rule>
  <rule>Include issue numbers without context</rule>
</avoid>

<never-stage>
  NEVER stage or commit build/runtime artifacts. Before running `git add`,
  verify that NONE of these are included:
  - Python: __pycache__/, *.pyc, *.pyo, .venv/, venv/, .mypy_cache/,
    .ruff_cache/, .pytest_cache/, *.egg-info/, dist/, build/, .tox/, .nox/
  - Node.js: node_modules/, .next/, .turbo/, .parcel-cache/
  - Rust: target/, *.rlib
  - Go: *.test binary outputs
  - Compiled: *.exe, *.dll, *.so, *.dylib, *.o, *.obj, *.a, *.wasm
  - JVM: *.class, *.jar, *.war, *.ear
  - .NET: bin/, obj/, *.nupkg
  - Terraform: .terraform/, *.tfstate
  - OS: .DS_Store, Thumbs.db
  Use `git add <specific-files>` instead of `git add .` or `git add -A`.
  If in doubt, run `git status` first and only stage source files.
</never-stage>
</commit-best-practices>

<git-identity>
  <rule name="author">ALWAYS use --author flag: git commit --author "Christian Berendt <berendt@23technologies.cloud>" -m "..."</rule>
  <rule name="co-authored-by">Do NOT add any Co-Authored-By trailer. Never add "Co-Authored-By: Claude" or similar.</rule>
  <rule name="trailers">Append these trailers at the end of the commit message body, separated by a blank line:
    AI-assisted: Claude Code
    On-behalf-of: @SAP christian.berendt@sap.com
    Signed-off-by: Christian Berendt <berendt@23technologies.cloud>
  </rule>
</git-identity>


<output-format>
OUTPUT ONLY THE COMMIT MESSAGE, nothing else. No markdown formatting.
Body should explain WHAT and WHY (2-4 sentences about what this planning document covers).
</output-format>
